sanskrit: kathaṃ vijñāyate śaṃbho etadicchāmi veditumvarṇamantra padādhvā ca kathayāmyanupūrvaśaḥbhuvanādhvā tu yatprokto mayā pūrvaṃ hi suvratepunaścāṣṭādaśaistatvaiḥ kalābhedaiḥ punasthitamtatsarvañcāṣṭabhirbhedairākṣiptaṃ punareva tuṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulañcāraṃ yanmayā kathitaṃ tavaāpādatalamadhvānamutsaheta varānanetattvādhvā ca varārohe teṣāñcordhvaṃ vyavasthitaḥkalādhvā tu sa eveti kathitastatra pūrvaśaḥṣaṭtṛṃśāṅgulaṃ parityajya kramavacca sumadhyamesvāmibhāvaṃ tu yattasmin dvādaśāntamavasthitaḥśaktyā dehasthito hyātmā niṣkalaḥ parameśvaraḥsusamiddhe yathā vahnau śikhālihati cāṃbaredīkṣākāle'bhimānantu tadvat kuryāttu deśikaḥśaktyāraṇibhūtāyā punastatra kṣipāmyahamatītaśśiva tadvahneḥ sa tu yojayate pareudite tu pare tatve tatrastho'pi na vāryatelīnassarvagato devi dharmādharma vivarjitaḥyāvadvaktramanuprāptaṃ dvibhāgaṃ tyajate tu saḥatītaṃ dvādaśānte tu śaktipadmaṃ prakīrtitamniṣkalaśśaktipadme tu prabuddhastatra tiṣṭhatina kālaṃ na kalācāraṃ na tatvā na ca devatātaṃ prāpya na nivartante bhayasaṃsārabandhaneetatte niṣkalaṃ tatvamuktameva samāsataḥtrividhaṃ tu parityajya śaktyantaṃ yastṛṭi smṛtaḥ

sanskrit: sa bhoktā sarvatatvānāṃ śaktyante yastṛṭismṛtaḥśaktyatīto varārohe tatvena saha yujyatetatra śakticatuṣkantu sūkṣmākhyaṃ parikīrtitamsarvatantreṣu sāmānyaṃ tatrasthaṃ viṣuvaṃ smṛtamsakalaṃ niṣkalañcaiva mayanañca tṛtīyakamtribhāgabhājite cāre niṣkalaḥ praṇavaḥ smṛtaḥsa cetasya smṛto jīvo yadā śaktyā tu yujyatecinmātrantu smṛto hutvā cetā śaktiḥ prakīrtitāsarvatantreṣu sāmānyaṃ tantrasthe viṣuvaṃ vadettathā yuktamidaṃ sarvaṃ nānāceṣṭāni kārayetkalpanārahitaṃ jñāṃ sarvatatvavivarjitametatte niṣkalañcāraṃ kathitantu mayākhilamkapaṭenopapannāya śravasyapi na dāpayetmūrtidevasya vikhyātā śaktyā devabhuvasya tubrahmādīnāṃ varārohe śūnyadehaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥśaktyavasthāntarī bhūtāssūkṣmādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥtṛtīyā tu varārohe jñātavyā deśikena tuta evamanurūpantu pañcamāṃ kathitaṃ tavatrividhaṃ mantradehantu veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥpṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva camantrarūpaṃ tathaiveha kathitaṃ tatvato mayāpañcabrahmāṇi deveśi veditavyāni yatnataḥtatvarūpaṃ tathaiveha pañcabrahmāḥ prakīrtitāḥvrajate śivasāyujyaṃ śivena sahamodateveditavyaṃ prayatnena siddhimokṣārthakāṅkṣibhiḥ

sanskrit: yena vijñātamātreṇa vidhimuktaṃ labheddhṛvamśabdavyomatayā jyotiḥ vigraho bhuvanastathāmantramūrtiṃ viditvā tu mantrasiddhimavāpnuyātbrahmādīnāṃ surendrāṇāṃ sādhane vigrahaṃ smaretśabdatatve pare līnaḥ śabdāntargatamānasaḥtasyātītaṃ paraṃ devi śaktivyomaprakīrtitamvigraho bhuvano jyotiḥ śabdacchāmantathaiva caśivamevaṃ vidhaṃ jñātvā sādhakastu samāhitaḥmantramūrtiparaṃ jñātvā siddhiṃ muktimāpnuyātbhuvanantu bhuvanākāraṃ brahmāṇḍādi yathākramamindranīlamahānīlaiḥ rājataiśca vibhūṣitamdivyasṛggandhavastrāḍhyaṃ divyaiśvaryasamanvitamvigrahaṃ vigrahākāraṃ śivavarṇādilakṣaṇamśūnyahastaṃ vṛṣārūḍhamumādehārdhasaṃyutamvigrahaṃ devadevasya sarvakāmārthasādhanamjyotidhyānātsadāyogī yogasiddhimavāpnuyātvyālākāramanākāraṃ vyomavyāpī paraśśivaḥnirguṇaṃ sāñjanātītaṃ gṛhanakṣatravarjitamvyomalīnamanāḥ samyak vyomastho vyomatanmayaḥśabdadhyānāt paromokṣaḥ siddhayaśca na saṃśayaḥvāmapārśve iḍā tasya ciñciṇīśabdamuttamamdakṣiṇena suṣumnā hi ciravyakrinī smṛtāghaṇṭānādavirāmāntāntyamadhyaparaṃ smṛtamciñciṇīcāravakyante nirālaṃbo nirāśrayaḥhṛdisthaṃ mantrasaṅghātaṃ kṛtvā mūrtinyasedbudhaḥ

sanskrit: sa tu cintayate nityaṃ tatrasthaṃ bindumīśvaramhaṃsākhyaścaiva binduśca nādo nādānta eva caetattatparamaṃ guhyametattatparamaṃ śivametattatparamaṃ jñānametattatparamākṣaramvidite saṃyagevaṃ hi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥeteṣāṃ parato devaḥ śabdarūpavivarjitaḥtaṃ viditvā vimucyante sidhyante nātra saṃśayaḥkathaṃ vijñāyate śaṃbho ratiguhyataraṃ paramtasyāhaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi lakṣaṇantu surārcitedivārātryośca madhye tu veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥpañcadhā tu parityajya praśāntaṃ śūnyamucyatenāsāyāntu yadātītaṃ tacchūnyañca tṛtīyakamayanaṃ śūnyamityuktaṃ kathitaṃ jñānamuttamamadhastāttu parityajya pañcadhā parameśvarietatpraśāntaśūnyantu jñātvā mucyeta bandhanātviditaṃ tadvarārohe dehamuktamidaṃ smṛtamūrdhvaśūnyamadhaśśūnyaṃ madhyaśśūnyaṃ tṛtīyakamsā mayā kathitā hyete caturthantu nirāmayamtena doṣāya vartante śeṣaṃ mahānulakṣaṇamna tasya kalpanā devi pāraṃparyeṇa saṃsthitaḥkriyātītantu tattatvaṃ gīyate sarvataśśubheevaṃ triśūnyabhedantu kathitaṃ tava suvṛtena tasya kalpanā devi pāraṃparyeṇa saṃsthitaḥkriyātītantu tattatvaṃ gīyate sarvataśśubheevaṃ triśūnyabhedantu kathitaṃ tava suvrate

sanskrit: tena jñātena saṃjñeyī dīkṣānugrahakṛt bhavetpañcavyomāḥ purā proktāḥ te tvayā viditāḥ śubhebrahmāṇamāditaḥ kṛtvā yāvaddevaḥ sadāśivaḥekaikaṃ pañcadhā devi veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥsvabhāvavarṇato devi jñeyaṃ vijñāyate yathāaṇavastrayamākhyātaṃ hṛtkarṇaṃ tālumāśritambrahmāviṣṇastathā rudra abhāvaḥ sūtravatsmṛtāḥtacchabdo nāda ityuktaḥ sa jīvaḥ kathitastavatatkṣayena na kiñcit syāt guruvaktraṃ saducyatemantrāstathaiva jñātavyā deśikena mahātmanāśrūyate ucyate caiva śivaśaktiviceṣṭitamsidhyate nātra sandehaḥ śivaśaktyupabṛṃhitaḥmantrāstasya na sidhyanti na ca yāti paraṃ padamkathitaṃ tatra sadbhāvaṃ tanmayā viditaṃ prabhoke ca kasmin gṛhādeva dīkṣitā devadānavāḥyakṣarākṣasabhūtāśca piśācoragakinnarāsvāntena dīkṣitādeva yasya siddhi dhruvaṃ bhavetkoṭibhedāḥ samākhyātāḥ śākhābhedāśca śaṅkaraśṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi tantrabhedamanuttamamdīkṣitāni mayā yasmin na śaṅkāśca yathā purāprakāśitaṃ purā devi mamedaṃ parameṣṭhināsaṃhartā ca na sandehaḥ mantramūrtiḥ paraśśivaḥdīkṣāvidhiniyogañca kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ yathāśrutamtasyādirbhagavān devaśśivo vai mantramūrtimāntena prakāśitaṃ pūrvaṃ śivenānandamūrtimān

sanskrit: mayāpi tatvadeveśi tvayā dattaṃ pitāmaheviṣṇunāpi hutāśāya tena dattantu vāyavesūryeṇa cāpi somāya kathitaṃ punareva tuevaṃ taddaśadhā jñānaṃ śivoktaṃ tatra saṅgrahesa eva jagataścāsya mantramūrtirmaheśvaraḥprāpyate devadeveśi mokṣañca bhuvi durlabhamlokodbhaveti rudreṇa punareva prakīrtitamkāraṇaṃ bhagavān brahmā ajiteti janārdanaḥsahasrāṃśeti dharmāya aṃśumāniti bhāskaraḥśivaśaktimadhiṣṭhāya vibhinnaṃ vai punasthitaḥevameti surāssarve śivajñānasya pāragāḥasyaiva jñānamukhyasya śivajñānasya sāṃpṛtamaṣṭādaśavidhairbhedaiḥ tatra bhedaiḥ punasthitaḥtasya bhedā bhavantyete saṃjñā ca parikīrtyatevijayaṃ prathamaṃ teṣāṃ niśvāsaṃ tadanantaramvīrabhadramiti khyātaṃ rauravaṃ mākuṭaṃ tathāprodgītaṃ lalitañcaiva siddhisantānameva caīśvaraḥ prathamaḥ prokto devī ca tadanantaramnandīśvaro mahākāla īśānaṃ candramāstathālalitā caiva caṇḍaśca śāntapāṇī tathaiva cavijayamīśvarajñānaṃ devyā niśvāsasaṃhitāmvīreṇa vīrabhadrastu nandīrauravameva cacandramāścandrabhāsañca jñānañcāṅgirasaṃ tathālalitaṃ lalitā devi daṇḍahastaṃ tathaiva cakiraṇaṃ brahmaṇā caiva parameśe pārameśvaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: te cāpyante mahābhāgāḥ kramārādyāśśacīpatiḥmantrabheda praṇetāro mantrakalpakarāstathānāmabhedaprasaṃkhyātamārādhya parameśvaramgaṇaguhyakabhedaiśca rudrabhedaiśca saṃjñitampunaścaiva samākhyātā naṣṭā daśavidhāstathātasmin mantrāḥ samākhyātāḥ śrūyatāṃ varavarṇinīekapañcāśatañcaiva tathā vai saptasaptatiḥvijaye tu samākhyātaṃ tasmin brahmā tu dīkṣitaḥaṣṭau caiva tu lakṣāṇi daśabhirmaṇḍalaisthitamśukraḥ kubero varuṇo yamaścaivāśvināvapiniśvāse tu pare tantre kathitaṃ tava śobhaneśatamekaṃ tathā cānyaṃ mantrāṇāṃ parisaṃkhyayāsaptavidyādharaṃ tantraṃ tathā svāyaṃbhuveti caprajānāṃ patayaścaiva tathā brahmasutāśca yeyakṣarākṣasagandharvāḥ piśācoragakinnarāḥsahasramekaṃ mantrāṇāṃ triṃśadbhirmaṇḍalaiḥ sthitamgātarodhe gṛhāścaiva ye ca vighnādayo gaṇāḥekādaśa sahasrāṇi koṭitrīṇi ca saṃgraheaṣṭādaśa vidhairbhedaiḥ loke mantragaṇān bahūnvisarpitañca saṃbodhaiḥ kūṭamudbhūtakāraṇaiḥatra te ṛṣayaṃssiddhāḥ balakhilyāstapodhanāḥanena caiva siddhānte devā vai mānavādayaḥkoṭirekaṃ sahasrañca mantramaṇḍalaviṃśakampañcamantraśatā jñeyāḥ caturmūrtivyavasthitāḥnalāntarmātṛkalpaiśca ṛṣibhiḥ sevyate sadā

sanskrit: maṇḍalāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ visarannāmanāmataḥdaśabhedāḥ samākhyātāḥ candrabhāsamiti smṛtamekamaṇḍalagūḍhantu nārasihmeti viśrutammayādyā nalinaścaiva nalinādyāśca yatra vaimantrairdvādaśabhiryuktaṃ maṇḍaladvayasaṃyutamdvisahasre śate dve ca maṇḍāśca trisaptatiḥyogināṃ paramo yatra mantrabhedaḥ pravartatetrayastriṃśatsamāyuktaṃ vidyāśaktiviceṣṭitammahāvratavidhānañca dīkṣāvidhisamudbhavaḥnāḍīsañcārasaṃyuktaṃ lalitaṃ pañcamaṃ calamdaśadhā maṇḍalākhyātaṃ siddhamityeva saṃjñitamkoṭidvayantu mantrāṇāṃ śatānāṃ parikīrtitamtrimaṇḍalamathājñeyaṃ gūḍhadevaistu kīrtitammaṇḍalānāṃ śatañcaiva śarvodgītamiti smṛtamkiraṇe hi samākhyātamādityo yatra dīkṣitaḥkoṭisaptasamākhyātaṃ mantrāṇāṃ niyutaṃ tathāsaṃkhyātā mantrabhedāśca śākhābhedāśca tatvataḥśivaproktā smṛtāṃhyete tantrakalpabahu smṛtāḥ*? tatvaṃ yāti saṃjñāśca vidyātatvaṃ śivātmakamgandharva yakṣarakṣāśca piśācā ṛṣayastathāmantrajāpena siddhāstu sarve te sādhakāḥ smṛtāḥidaṃ sāramidaṃ sāraṃ yassarvaṃ jñātumicchativijñāyākṣaratanmātraṃ gurumārādhya yatnataḥtatprasādādbhavenmuktiḥ saṃsārabhavabandhanāttatvamācakṣva deveśa yadi syādvarado mama

sanskrit: yatra tatvañca deveśa utkrāntisiddhisādhanamtena sarvamidaṃ kāryaṃ tena sarvamidaṃ tatamkasmin kasmin pradeśe tu draṣṭavyaṃ bindumīśvaramnādañcaiva tathā śaktiḥ hṛllakṣasya ca darśanamśṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ rahasyamidamuttamamnavātmakena sarveśi yathā bhavati tacchṛṇunādaṃ tasya śikhā proktā śaktistu paramaṃ sthitāguruvakrācca labhyeta yathā tenaiva coditaḥyathā karmāṇi kurute kathayāmi tavākhilamanādiparamaṃ jñānaṃ anādi paramavyayamyathā prāpsyasi tannādaṃ binduśca bhuvi durlabhambhruvormadhye samākhyātaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaravarjitaṃ darśatatvaiśca darśatatvaprakāśakamdīpau tasya samākhyātau ubhau tau śaśi bhāskarauiḍā dṛśyati vāmena suṣumnā dakṣiṇena tughaṭamadhye yathā dīpaḥ tadghaṭaṃ vai prakāśateyathā'darśo malairgrastaḥ pratibiṃbaṃ na dṛśyateubhayorapi pāṇibhyāṃ dhārasaṃsthāpya buddhimānnāsā śrotraṃ tathā cakṣuḥ ubhayorapicchādayetchādanāt tyajyate binduḥ śuddhasphaṭikanirmalaḥśabdanādavinirmuktaṃ dhyātavyaṃ paramaṃ śivamyathā sarvagato vāyuṃ pīṭhastho na ca dṛśyatearaṇistho yathā vahniḥ vidyamāno na dṛśyatesaṃyogena tathā binduḥ pratyakṣo dṛśyate tadātadvat sarvagato binduḥ yogahīno na dṛśyate

sanskrit: prāpyate ca tathā binduḥ yogināñca mahātmanāmprakāśayati tattoyaṃ ātmakīḍena tejasātadvadyogavihīnasya binduścaiva na dṛśyatedhyānaṃ yogaṃ samākhyāya paśyate bindumīśvaramparatvādaparaṃ nāsti nityayuktaṃ sadā bhavetkathitaṃ sa rahasyantu jñātavyaṃ yogibhissadāvijñeyā ca sadā devi śikhā tasyaiva madhyataḥtallayassatataṃ yogī lakṣayetsusamāhitaḥnava tatvāni deveśi yānyuktāni navātmakeādihuṅkārasaṃyuktaḥ saptaite bhuvidurlabhāḥsadyassaṅkrāmaṇantyete ekameva niyojitāḥhākārarūpasaṃyogāt cintyamānastu sotkramātakārādimakārāntā makārokārayojitāḥetāssaptasamākhyātāḥ kṣurikāḥ prāṇahārikāḥsaptānāntu samākhyātamaṣṭa oṅkāra ucyateoṅkāraṃ sarvadevatyaṃ sarvavyāpī paraśśivaḥtatra cotpadyate śaṃbhuḥ śabdātītastu niṣkalaḥnānāmārgasthito vyāpī sarvalokasya durlabhaḥhṛdaye caiva karṇe ca bhruvormadhye tathaiva caturyadvāramiti proktaṃ devayānamiti smṛtamdevatānāṃ trayañcaiva śaktitrayamiti smṛtamsarvagaḥ sarvato vyāpī sarvamāpūryatiṣṭhatipadmasya karṇikāmadhye brahmā tatra vyavasthitaḥtālujihvamiti khyātaṃ dvitīyaṃ sthānamucyatelavaṃ kasya tu tatsthānaṃ kathitaṃ tava śobhane

sanskrit: svatatvaṃ madhyataḥ kṛtvā yaṣṭavyāni dine dineśivāṅgā ye janāḥ proktāḥ karṇikāyāṃ vyavasthitāḥeṣa eva vidhirdeviḥ prakṛtyādi śivāntikāḥuttiṣṭhantardhāne ca pādacāre tathaiva caguḍikākāśagamane dantakāṣṭhe pavitrakepūrvasūtreṇa tu ye proktāḥ tatsarvaṃ labhate naraḥpunaśca śṛṇu deveśi yajanaṃ kathayāmi tesakalīkṛtya deveśi niṣkalena śivaṃ smaretsakalaṃ hṛdayaṃ devi sakalāḍhyaṃ śirasmṛtamkṣayāntamastramityuktaṃ śivāṅgāḥ parikīrtitāḥvidyāṅgāste tu vijñeyāḥ pūrvasūtre tu ye smṛtāḥdakṣiṇena śikhāṃ dadyāt kavacaṃ paścimena tuvidyāṅgā hṛdayaṃ devi āgneyyāṃ parikalpayetdvitīyāvaraṇe mantratatvāni parikalpayeteṣate kathyate devi tatvānāṃ yajanaṃ pratievaṃ yaṣṭvā tu tatvāni japeccaiva navātmakammanasā cintitaṃ sarvaṃ saṃpādayati mantriṇaḥdvirāvaraṇametaddhi yajanaṃ samudāhṛtamtribhirāvaraṇaistatvānyaṣṭvā siddhimavāpnuyātgarbhāvaraṇametaddhi kartavyaṃ surasundarievaṃ tatvagaṇān devi yaṣṭvā siddhimavāpnuyātyaṃ yaṣṭvā sidhyate mantraṃ mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥnānena sadṛśaṃ yāgaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vidyatepañcabrahma śivāṅgaiśca garbhametattu kalpayetpūrvasūtre tu yatproktā aṅgāścaiva navātmake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navātmapañcabhirbhedaiḥ yanmayā parikīrtitamevaṃ yaṣṭvā tato mantrī japayogaṃ samārabhetbudhvā smṛtvā ca mucyante sādhakājjanmabandhanātyanna kasyacidākhyātaṃ kathayāmi tavākhilamnyāsamātreṇa mucyante sādhakājjanmabandhanātparamākṣaraṃ nyasettatra karṇikāyāntu mantriṇāparamākṣarasya yogoyamevaṃ te samudāhṛtampūrvapatre punardevi vinyasetparamākṣaramkalāḍhyaṃ naiṛte caiva khamalaṃ paścime tathāīśānyāṃ vinyasenmantrī kaṇṭhoṣṭhaṃ parameśvariāgneyyāṃ niṣkalaṃ tatra karṇikāyāntu vinyasetdakṣiṇe śūnyatatvantu kalāḍhyaṃ nair-ṛtena tukṣayāntamuttareṇaiva kaṇṭhoṣṭhaṃ naiśagocaredakṣiṇe karṇikāyāntu śūnyatatvantu vinyasetparamākṣaraṃ nyaseddevi dakṣiṇe samudāhṛtamkṣapaṇaṃ vāyudeśe tu vinyasetsamudāhṛtamnair-ṛte karṇikāyāntu kalāḍhyaṃ vinyasecchubheśūnyaṃ dakṣiṇato nyasya nair-ṛtyāṃ paramākṣaramkṣayāntamuttareṇaiva kaṇṭhoṣṭhamīśagocarepaścime karṇikāyāntu khamalaḥ parikīrtitaḥdakṣiṇe śūnyatatvantu kalāḍhyaṃ nair-ṛtena tuvāyavyāṃ kṣapaṇaṃ caiva kṣayāntañcottareṇa tuvāyavyāṃ karṇikāyāntu kṣapaṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥśūnyañca dakṣiṇe caiva kalāḍhyaṃ naiṛtena tuuttare tu kṣayāntañca kaṇṭhoṣṭhyamīśagocare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: uttare karṇikāpīṭhe kṣayāntaṃ tatvavinyasetdakṣiṇe śūnyamityuktaṃ kalāḍhyaṃ naiṛtena tuparamākṣarantu deveśi uttareṇa tu vinyasetsaptamaṃ te samākhyātaṃ tatvaṃ sukharārcitepūrvapatre tu sakalamāgneyyāṃ niṣkalaṃ paramkhamalaṃ paścime caiva kṣapaṇaṃ vāyugocareaṣṭamaṃ te samākhyātaṃ pīṭhaṃ paramadurlabhamna mayā kasyacitkhyāta yāga eṣa sudurlabhaḥvrajate śivasāyujyaṃ nirmalo vigatajvaraḥpañcāṃśena śatenaiva dīkṣāṃ kurvīta deśikaḥkartavyaṃ deśikendreṇa homakarma yathākramamsvacittasyānusāreṇa yajanantu samārabhetekāśīti vibhāgantu kathitaṃ tava śobhaneekenāvaraṇenaiva yajennityaṃ samāhitaḥevaṃ * * * * ? yāgāḥ kathitā hyanupūrvaśaḥpṛthivī tena sakalā sarāṣṭrā nāpasaṃyutāsa jñānī bhūtale nityaṃ sādhakaḥ sa śivaṃ nayetprayānti nātra sandeho jñānavicchinnabandhanātcatvāro hi mahāyāgāḥ akathyeyā varānanesthaṇḍile maṇḍale vā'pi vāyurākāśameva camanasā cakṣuṣā caiva vacasā ca na saṃśayaḥebhyaḥ pravartate sarvaṃ asmin sarvamidaṃ smṛtampūrvoktantu vidhiṃ kuryāt karṇikāyāṃ maheśvaripañcabrahmakalaiścaiva śivāṅgaiśca samanvitaḥpañcabhiḥ brahmabhiścaiva vidhiṃ kuryādaśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: īśānaṃ madhyato dadyāt pūrvaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ nyasetsadyojātantu deveśi paścimena tu vinyasetnaiṛtyāntu śikhāṃ devi vāyavyāṃ kavacaṃ nyasetdvitīyāvaraṇaṃ devi kathyamānaṃ mayā śṛṇusvanaṃ dakṣiṇato nyasya śabdaṃ naiṛtake nyasetuttareṇaiva jhaṅkāraṃ dhvaṅkṛtaṃtvīśagocareukārādi smṛtā ye tu ghoṣādīnāñca vācakāḥsakalaṃ pūrvavaktre tu āgneyyāṃ niṣkalaṃ nyasetkhamalaṃ paścimenaiva kṣapaṇaṃ vāyugocareparamākṣarantu deveśi madhyadeśe tu vinyasetcaturāvaraṇaṃ devi prakṛtyantaṃ tu vinyaseteṣa yāgaparaṃ devi kathitaṃ hyanupūrvaśaḥsiddhidaṃ muktidañcaiva nānena sadṛśaṃ bhavetśāntyatītantu hṛdayaṃ āgneyyāṃ parikalpayeteṣa sādāśivo yogaḥ kathitastava śobhaneiḍikā dīpikā caiva recikā mocikā tathāūrdhvagāmini deveśi nyasedāgneyagocaredīpikāntu mahābhāge vāyavyāṃ parikalpayethuṅkārantu śikhā proktā haiṃkāraṃ kavacaṃ bhavetgarbhāvaraṇametaddhi kathitaṃ surasundariasya guhyataraṃ vakṣye śaktiyāgamanuttamamnānena kathitā martyā dīkṣānugrahakārakāḥtasmācchreṣṭhopariṣṭhaśca nākhyena paridīkṣaṇeadhivāsanañcaivatri sarvaśeṣavivarjitamsarvasaṃhitasāmānyaṃ yanmahatsarvatomukham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nyāsamātreṇa mucyante sādhakājanmabandhanātāsanaṃ kalpayenmantrī tatra nyāsantu kārayetpūjayitvā vidhānena devadevaṃ maheśvaramaghoraṃ dakṣiṇe caiva vāmadevaṃ tathottareāgneyyāṃ hṛdayañcaiva īśānyāntu śiro nyasetastraṃ diśāsu vinyasya makārādyāstu ye smṛtāḥdakṣiṇe karṇikāpīṭhe vinyasecca navātmakaṃśiraḥ śikhā ca kavacamastrañcaiva yathākramampaścime niyatiṃ dadyāt vāyavyāṃ kalavinyasetīśvaraṃ pūrvatatvaṃ āgneyyāṃ tu sadāśivamāgneyyāṃ hṛdayañcaiva īśānyāntu śironyasetuttare karṇikāyāntu praṇavaḥ parikalpayetvidyāśikhā samākhyātā pratiṣṭhāṃ kavacaṃ viduḥghoṣantu pūrvadigbhāge āgneyyāṃ ravameva capaścimena smṛtaḥ sphoṭo dhvaniḥ vāyavyato nyasetpūrvataḥ karṇikāmadhye rudroṅkārantu vinyasetnaiṛtyāntu śikhā proktā vāyavyāṃ kavacaṃ tathāśāntiṃ pūrvadiśābhāge vidyāṃ dakṣiṇato nyasetśāntyatītaṃ paraṃ tatvamastraṃ devasya kīrtitamamṛtācāgnidigbhāge kathitā tatvaśobhaneeṣa yāgavaro devi nāmṛtaḥ kasyacinmayāevaṃ yaṣṭvā tu vidhinā dīkṣāṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥpañcasvaśikhāṃ hutvā dīkṣānirvāṇagāminīprakriyāśūnyamantrāṇāṃ śāsanaṃ grahaṇaṃ tathāchedanaṃ kutra vā teṣāṃ śuddhatatvasya śaṅkara
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tritatvaṃ paratatvañca tadeva kathayasva meyāni śreyastamānisyuḥ kathayasva prasādataḥtadasmin sarvamasmākaṃ kathayasva prasādataḥguhyāt guhyataraṃ devi nākhyātaṃ kasyacinmayāanantamāditaḥ kṛtvā śivatatvamapaścimamadhastātparameśāno hyanantaḥ parameśvaraḥyāmye śrotā tava proktā tasya te bhuvanā smṛtāḥtasyopari samākhyātā narakā ghorarūpiṇaḥanukrameṇa tān sarvān śodhayet parameśvariśodhanīyāstu deveśi krameṇa varavarṇinīkathitāstu samāsena ekaviṃśadanukramāttriguṇena sthitā devi pātālena samāsataḥekadhā caiva mānuṣyā jñeyaṃ saṃsāramaṇḍalamevaṃ saṃsāracakrantu kathitaṃ tava śobhanehaviryajñāḥ pākayajñāḥ somasaṃkhyāstathaiva tuaṣṭādhikāśca jñātavyaṃ deśikena tupadaṃ prāpya parityajya antyeṣṭastadanantarambhogasthāneṣu saṃyojya tasmādbhogādviyojayetbhūrloke tu tato yojya bhuvarlokaṃ tato nayetrudrāsane tato yojya saddhi daṇḍakrameṇa tutena cāhutayassapta dadyācchudhyarthakāraṇātevantu pṛthivī śuddhā śatarudrastu yojitāśatamekonaṣaṣṭiñca kathitaṃ tava śobhaneprīṇayitvā kṛtān prājñaḥ tatve tatve yathākramambhuvanāntarnivāsīnāṃ śikhenaivāhutiṃ hunet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pārthivāvaraṇaṃ devi anantādiranukramātśatadvayaṃ samākhyātaṃ tathā caikona saptatiḥpañcāṣṭakaṃ punaśśodhyaṃ pañcadhāvaraṇaiḥ kramātkrodhāṣṭakantu jñātavyaṃ deśikena mahātmanātejoṣṭake tu saṃśuddhe śivadvādaśakaṃ punaḥmaṇḍalādhipatiñcaiva kathitaṃ tava śobhaneguṇatrayaṃ buddhitatvaṃ śodhanīyaṃ yathākramamkrodhatejoṣṭakaṃ śodhyaṃ yogibhiḥ sa śivaissahagurupaṅktitrayaṃ devi gurorantaritāstathāetatpradhānamityuktaṃ bahuvistarataḥ sthitamtayo rūpāḥ samākhyātāḥ tatvānāntu purā mayāanantamāditaḥ kṛtvā pradhānāntastathāvadhiataḥ paratarañcaiva puruṣaṃ kathayāmi teaṃbhādyāḥ śodhane tatra pauruṣe tu yathākramamdharmo daśavidhaḥ proktaḥ tava devi na saṃśayaḥahaṃkārastu trividho guṇatrayamudāhṛtamvigrahāṣṭakasaṃyuktā śodhanīyāḥ prayatnataḥvyādhiśca śāśvato loke kṣuttṛṣṇāśokameva carāṇaśśokaśca mohaśca madamātsaryameva caete bandhātmakā pāśāḥ gaṇapāśīmato'nyathādeśapāśāstu ye tasya śivena parikīrtitāḥśatapañcāśatenaiva pañcaviṃśena vā punaḥekāhutyā tu deveśi śodhanīyāḥ śivādhvaredhyātvā bhaktimayaṃ śiṣyaṃ dīkṣāṃ kuryāttu deśikaḥśatamekantu vikhyātā niyatyāṃ bhuvanādhipāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śuklakṛṣṇavibhāgasthāṃ dhyātvā śodhyeta mokṣakaḥkālatatve tu vikhyātā koṭyanekaparigrahāḥsuhṛṣṭaḥ suprahṛṣṭaśca surūpo rūpavardhaniḥataḥ paratareṇaiva vidyeśānāḥ prakīrtitāḥvidyātatve tu jñātavyāḥ deśikena mahātmanāvidhinā śodhanīyāstu deśikena mahātmanāgopateśca tadordhvantu grathidvāre vyavasthitāḥataḥ paratareṇaiva trikālaḥ kṣemīśa eva cayogakṣemapradātārā dīkṣādhvānaviśodhitāḥmadamohasamāyuktaṃ evamādimahāśayechaṅkārasādhyamoṅkāra dātāradavaneśikampramāṇāṣṭakamevāpi māyāvaraṇasaṃsthitaḥevamādīni hutvā tu munetmanāṃ vidhānavitebhyo madhye tu ye rudrāḥ kathayāmyanupūrvaśaḥrage'pi ca daśa proktāḥ vidyāyāṃ na punardaśaupariṣṭātpunaḥ pañcamāyātatvā tu saṃsthitāḥmadamohādi saṃyuktāḥ pāśahastā mahābalāḥsaṃkhyā vai bhuvanānāntu saptatiḥ saptacādhikāḥanantamāditaḥ kṛtvā māyātatvamapaścimamekasaṃśīkṛtāssarve kathayāmi tavākhilambhuvanā saptacādhikyaṃ kathitaṃ tava śobhaneātmatatvamidaṃ khyātaṃ māyāntaṃ surasundariananteśāditaḥ kṛtvā hotavyamanupūrvaśaḥīśvare śodhanīyāstu māyāñjanavivarjitāḥvāmājjyeṣṭhādayastasmāt śaktayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāṃ viditvā mahādevi deśikaḥ pāśahā bhavetdvau rudrau tu samākhyātau yogamokṣaphalapradaucatvārastu smṛtā rudrāḥ yogamokṣa phalapradāḥatopari dhruvaṃ devi rudraikādaśakaṃ punaḥteṣāṃ tu parato devi dhruvaścaiva tṛtīyakaḥato nirañjanaṃ proktaṃ tasya saṃkhyā na vidyateataścaivopariṣṭāttu aṣṭau te bhuvaneśvarāḥśodhanīyā varārohe yogakṣemapradāyakāḥataḥ paraṃ nirālaṃbaṃ sarvadhyāna vivarjitamnāparaṃ na parañcaiva parāparavivarjitampāraṃparyeṇa saṃsthañca nirmalaṃ paramaṃ padamtena sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ kalpanātītalakṣaṇamotaprotamanādyantaṃ sarvatatvāvabhāsakametatte kathitaṃ devi bhuvanānāṃ samāsataḥvidyātatve tu deveśi bhuvaneśāḥ prakīrtitāḥtān pravakṣyāhaṃ devi guṇatatvena suvrateviditvā śodhane devi deśikaḥ tatvapāragaḥekasaṃkhyaikataḥ kṛtvā pravakṣyāmi varānaneviṃśadvayañca jñātavyaṃ deśikena mahātmanāpūrṇāhutyā śatenāpi viśuddhyate nātra saṃśayaḥpraśāntena trayaḥ proktāḥ sarvādhvānamaśeṣataḥpraṇavena samākhyātaṃ śāntyatītena vā punaḥkālādhvanaṃ varārohe bhuvanādhvena homayetkalādhvāne tathaiveha kathitaṃ tava śobhaneveditavyaṃ prayatnena deśikena mahātmanā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: upapannāya dāntāya gurudevaratāya capūjayitvā vidhānena devadevaṃ maheśvaramsavyahaste tu yaṣṭavyaṃ vāmahastena saṃvrategandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ yathā nyāyaṃ pūjayitvā vidhānavitātmanyevaṃ vaśīkṛtya śiṣyasya parameśvaritatvāni dehato'nyasya sthānantu śirasi nyasetdhyātvā devaṃ maheśānaṃ bhūmimadhye tu tatvavitevaṃ kṛte tato devi śivahasteti sa smṛtaḥanena vidhinā devi kuryāttasyāpyanugrahambhūtapretapiśācebhyo rākṣasebhyassamādhipeadhvānaṃ kurute sohi na tu na vyāpayetparamputrako yena deveśi kathyate śivayogibhiḥgaṇayāgāditaḥ kṛtvā dṛṣṭvā khermaṇḍalāni tuyojitastu pare tatve putrakassa vidhīyatemantrakalpasuvettā ca deśakālavidhānavittāpane dīpane caiva chedane ca tathaiva caparamantravibhedajño mantrāpyāyanatatparaḥpātane daityabhūtebhyaḥ siṃhavidyādhareṣvapisamarthaśca parityāgī japāsaktassadā mataḥutsāhavān sadā dakṣaḥ sādhakassa vidhīyateabhiṣekapradātavyaṃ deśikena mahātmanāabhiṣiñcettataḥ śiṣyaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇāsaṃpuṭīkṛtya paścāttu vidyākhyenābhiṣecayetpṛthivīmāditaḥ kṛtvā nirvāṇāntena śobhanemaṇḍalasyeśabhāge tu kuryādvai caturaṅgakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: toraṇaissapatākaiśca diśāsu vidiśāsu caakālamūlakalaśaiścandanenopalepitaiḥsarvoṣadhi samāyuktaiḥ ekaikaṃ kalaśaṃ kuruekaikakalaśe devi vinyaseta yathākramampṛthivyādīni kalaśe vinyaseta yathākramamvedaśabdajayākāraiḥ pūrvādārabhya śobhanenirvāṇakalaśaṃ yāvat eṣa eva vidhismṛtaḥarghyādibhissamabhyarcya adhikāraṃ samarpayetkartavyo'nugrahaṃ nityaṃ caturāśramasaṃyutamsvalpamahni japaṃ kāryaṃ svalpamanhau tu homayetete'dhikārā ye proktāḥ śivajñāne vikalpitāḥevaṃ kurvāmahe tāta yattvayā kathitaṃ mamaevaṃ tvaṃ pūjayitvā tu ācāryaḥ sumahāmatiḥvisarjite tato devi gurupūjāmupakramettatrasthaṃ sthāpya pūjyeta yathāvidhi purassaramyathā bhagavataḥ pūjāṃ kuryādācāryakasya tuśivavatpūjayeddevi ācāryaṃ tantrapāragamtatprasādādbhavetsiddhiḥ muktiścaiva śivoditākarṇikākaṭakairvastraiḥ mekhalairmakuṭaistathāhastyaśvarathayānaiśca rukmabhedaiśca saṃyutamyena yena sutuṣṭena na tattat dadyāttu putrakaḥnivedite tato devi anṛṇo jāyate guroḥbhojayedgurubhaktāṃśca dīnānāthāṃśca tarpayetvaktavyantu tato devi prīyatāṃ bhagavāñcchivaḥanyathā kurute yastu ācāryaṃ pratisādhakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ācāryaṃ śivavanmantā vidyāccaiśvarasādhakammānyāḥ pūjyāśca deveśi anyonyaprītitāṃ vrajettatvenāpi vidhijñena dīkṣitaḥ śivatāṃ vrajetna tasya hanyate siddhiḥ yāvaddevaḥ sadāśivaḥācāryasya tu deveśe samayī putrakasya casarvathā sarvamāno'pi tatvavinmocayetpaśummānuṣīṃ tanumāsādya śive jñātaṃ prayacchatimāyā tasya na kartavyā kṛtvā māyāṃ vrajatyayampratyekaṃ saṃsmṛtā mantrāḥ mayā proktāstu suvratepañcabrahmaśivāṅgaiśca vidyāṅgāni tathaiva caśāntyatītañca praṇavaṃ tathā caiva navātmakamyatra pratyekahomasyāt tatra sādhāraṇairyajetpraṇave kathitā ye tu te tu pratyekaśasmṛtāḥpadabhedavibhāgena aṣṭatriṃśatkalaistathāśodhyaśodhakabhāvena tathā cānye prakīrtitāḥdaśayā dīpitairmantraiḥ karmakuryādyathepsitamhuṅkāramādiyogena svāhāntena tu mantriṇamoṅkāramāditaḥ kṛtvā vauṣaḍantena mantriṇaḥoṅkāradīpitā mantrā namaskārāntayojitāḥsuvauṣaṭkārasaṃyuktaṃ puṣyarthe viniyojayetmanonmaneti mantrāṇāṃ indyanārthaṃ prayojayetmāraṇe phaṭ phaḍityeva mantraṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥphaṭkāramantrayogena pāśacchedakarasmṛtimaviditvā na sidhyeta na ca yāti paraṃ padamsidhyante sādhakendrāstu prayogairmantrayojitaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dīkṣā homaṃ sadā kuryāt svāhākārāntikaṃ padamvauṣaḍantena deveśi pūrṇāhutyāntu dāpayetpañcaṣaṭ saptacāṣṭau tu bahvakṣaramayaḥ paraḥāpādatalamūrdhāntaṃ vyāpayitvā vyavasthitaḥcaturviṃśatibhistatvaiḥ prakṛtibhiḥ parikīrtitaḥbhuvanārthaṃ caturviṃśat vyākhyātāni śivena tukathitaṃ viṣṇudaivatyaṃ hṛdayāt karṇikāvadhiviṣṇunā saha modante viṣṇutulyaparākramāḥvidyāvidyeśvaraiścaiva tatra te bhuvanaissahakrīḍate rudraloke tu rudratulyabalo bhuvisa tatra īśvaro devaḥ ādhipatyena saṃsthitaḥtatra devaḥ sadākhyastu ādhipatyena saṃsthitaḥsthūlasūkṣmavibhāgena viditvā mokṣamāpnuyātiḍikādīpikā caiva rocikā mocikā tathākalāhyetāstu catvāraḥ ekatve tu yadā sthitāḥsūkṣmamekavidhañcaiva ūrdhvagāmīti viśrutamvyāptiyogena jñātavyā devatāhyaghanāśanāḥsūkṣmā caiva susūkṣmā ca amṛtā ca mṛtāmṛtātasyāpi parataḥ sūkṣmā vyāpinītyabhidhīyatetaṃ viditvā vimucyante narāssaṃsārasāgarāttasmin śūnyalayaṃ devi vighnantīṃ vinirdiśetkaṇṭhastho viramecchabdaḥ ardhacandra iti smṛtaḥnirodhī sā vinirdiṣṭā lalāṭe tu layaṃ viduḥabhinno ghāṭamityuktaṃ lalāṭe tu layaṃ viduḥabhinno ghāṭamityuktaṃ lalāṭastho nivartate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nādatatvalaye līnā sa paratvena gacchatitasmādgurutaro devi gurupāraṃparāgataḥjapayogavinirmuktaṃ karaṇādhāravarjitamkliśyante devatāssarve ṛṣayaḥ sāṃśatavratāḥetatsarvaṃ paratvena kathitaṃ tatvamuttamammantramuccārato devi yāvannānyamano bhavetnamaskāraṃ tataḥ proktaṃ svāhākārāntayojitamprāṇe tu taccaturthī tu vibhedavaravarṇinīuttarāyaṇapūrvāhṇe dvitīye dakṣiṇāyanamcatvāro viṣuvā devi jānīte deśikottamaḥetatsarvaṃ samāsena mayā tu kathitaṃ tavamantraṃ samaraso devi śivena parikīrtitaḥnāḍīsamaraso devi kathitastava śobhanesa bhūtasamaraso devi mayā te parikīrtitaḥtatvaṃ samāsato devi śivena kathitaṃ mamana mayā kasyacitkhyātaṃ tatvaṃ samarasaṃ śubhamtatvasandhānadeveśi tatvataḥ kathayāmi teśivādi tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā anupūrveṇa mantravitnāticitramapāyasya sūtracchedaṃ tathaiva caetān hutvā tato mantrī mantrāṇāṃ dīpanaṃ hunethuṅkāramādimadhyeṣu ante caiva prayojayetevaṃ sandīpanaṃ kṛtvā paśorathe varānaneśivatatve tu vidyākhyāmātmatatvañca vidyayātatastu śivatatvena sandhayīta vicakṣaṇaḥvidyeśāṃ śivatatvena lokeśān vidyasaṃjñite
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evantu sandhānaṃ kṛtvā pūrṇāhutyā tu pātayetsa dhūmaściṭaciṭāśabdo viṣṇuliṅgairvirājitaḥnīlamamranibhākāraṃ sa dhūmaṃ śālikā mataḥvistaraṃ ghorarūpañca sa dhūmañca likhenmahīmsarveṣāṃ rūpamādhatte kṛṣyamāno'pi pāvakaḥupapātakināścānye tānyevamupalakṣayetuṣṭragṛdhrasvarāghorāḥ śivāvānararāvakāḥjalate kradhukā śabdaḥ phaṭkāraśca sakṛt sakṛtdṛṣṭvaitānyapacihnāni dīkṣākarma na kārayethomayeddīpanañcaiva navatatvālayaṃ prabhuḥpaścāttatvakṛtaṃ tatvaṃ punarhomakṛtena tuyathā viṣaṃ mahāghoraṃ saptadhātugataṃ haretbrahmahatyādipāpāni upapātakināṃ tathāevaṃ saṃśodhya śiṣyantu dīkṣākarma samārabhetkathayā doṣamāyāti tasmātkruddhaṃ vivarjayetprakriyāsūtrayogañca pāśānāṃ grahaṇaṃ tathākanyā kartṛtvasūtreṇa triguṇītriguṇī kṛtearcyekādaśakenaiva tatsūtrantu vicakṣaṇaḥpādāṅguṣṭhapradeśe tu sūtraṃ kṛtvā pradhārayetsakalīkṛtya tatsūtraṃ sarvamantrairvicakṣaṇaḥtena pāśāni saṃgṛhya sūtragranthyā tu kārayettatvena bandhayedbhūyaḥ tān pāśāṃstu vicakṣaṇaḥbadhvā pāśaṃ yathānyāyaṃ vāsayeddeva saṃyutamdīpayeta tataḥ pāśāṃ huṃphaḍantaḥ krameṇa tuprabhāte vimale mantrī pradīptehani suvṛte
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: homānte tu tato mantrī pāśacchedantu kārayethutvā pāśāṃ tato mantrī pūrṇāhutyā tu pātayettatsthānāttataḥ pāśān tatvaṃ tatvena sandhayetvilīnamānaṃ saṃcintya sandhītakaraṇānvitampṛthivīmāditaḥ kṛtvā śivatatvamapaścimamtatvānāṃ sandhanañcaiva eṣa eva vidhismṛtaḥvarṇādhve ca padādhve ca mantrādhve ca tathaiva hibhuvanādhve tataḥ kuryāt kathayāmi samāsataḥgandhairdhūpaiḥ samabhyarcya tato yonivikalpanamśikhayā tāḍanaṃ kṛtvā grāhyasaṃhāramudrayādvādaśāntamanuprāptaṃ tato grāhyaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥadhikāre daśā dadyāt bhoge dadyāddaśāhutiḥviyojya mantravit prājñaḥ pāśacchedantu kārayetpūrṇāhutiṃ tatonte tu raudraṃ tasmāttu uddharetvidhimevaṃ sakṛt jñātvā mocayennātra saṃśayaḥtatvamāvāhayeddevi tato homaṃ prakalpayetśivena yojayettatra hunettenaiva suvṛtetritatvādhvaraśuddhe ca śikhācchedantu kārayetyojite tu pare tatve staumyamāhutayo hunetparitṛpto bhavasveti nirvāṇaṃ bhavasveti casarvavyāpīti hotavyaṃ deśikena mahātmanāyaduktaṃ devadevena tadbhavennātra saṃśayaḥvarṇādhvāne tathā proktaṃ kartavyaṃ deśikena tupraṇave yojanañcaiva tāḍane praṇavasmṛtaḥvarṇādhvāne yathā proktaṃ padādhvāne tathaiva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mantrādhvānaṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepānna tu vistarātsāvitryā tāḍanaṃ kuryāt grāhyaṃ tenaiva mantrataḥutkarṣaṇantu tenaiva sāvitryā tu vicakṣaṇaḥpūrṇāhutiḥ pradātavyā yojanāya pare śiveeṣa eva vidhirdevi kathito hyanupūrvaśaḥsarvasaṃhitasāmānyaṃ kathitaṃ tava śobhanetadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi sādhakānāṃ hitāvahamanantadharmajñānañca vairāgyaiśvaryameva capadmañca candanaṃ tena karṇikāntena kārayetdevatāntena kartavyā mūrtyantenaiva kārayetāvāhanantu tenaiva kartavyaṃ surasundarinivṛttistu śirastasya iḍikāhṛdayaṃ viduḥpṛthivī tu bhavedastraṃ brahmaṇāṅgāḥ prakīrtitāḥpaścimenottareṇaiva madhye praṇavasaṃyutamśikhā naiṛtadigbhāge kavacaṃ vāyugocareikārastu śikhā devi akārastu śirasmṛtamlakāramastramityuktaṃ grāhakāḥ parikīrtitāḥbhūtatvaṃ brahmatatvasya praṇavena tu homayetyojane sādhakendrāya prajanatvamapāśritebrahmaṇe tu yathā proktaṃ viṣṇave'pi tathā smṛtamrukāro hṛdayaṃ proktamīkārastu śikhā smṛtāpūrvoktena vidhānena kuryādāvāhanaṃ budhaḥanādye tu pade devi viṣṇusāyujyatāṃ vrajetvidyāśirassamākhyātamaṅgāraṃ nāma nāmataḥaghoraṃ kavacaṃ devi rudratatvasya śobhane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āsane'yaṃ vidhirdevi mayā te parikīrtitāḥvidyāśirassamākhyātaṃ makāraṃ nāma nāmataḥyakāramastramityuktamaṅgānyetāni ceśvarianantā rudratatvasya nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ padamnidhanena tu kartavyaṃ tatvena tu sadāśiveparamākṣaraṃ śikhā tasya śāntyatītaṃ śirasmṛtamśūnyatatvaṃ hakārastu astraṃ tatparikīrtitamete pañcamahāyāgā nākhyātā kasyacinmayāteṣāmuddharaṇārthāya mayā tu kathitaṃ tavanaiṣṭhikānāntu kartavyaṃ liṅgoddhāraṃ samīritamathavā brahmavidye tu abhiyuktastu sādhakaḥvaiṣṇave'pi tathaiveha kathitaṃ parameṣṭhināgaṇaguhyakamantreṣu sādhanenaiva sādhakaḥḍākinyo mātaraścaiva yoginyo'pi tathā parāḥīśvare pāśupatyānāṃ uddhāre tu vicakṣaṇaḥśuddhāyuktastu etasmin dīkṣitena muktimicchatāyajeddevādideveśaṃ sarveṣāṃ phalamāpnuyāteṣa te yoga ākhyātaḥ pañcavyomātmakaśśubhaḥcaturāvaraṇairyāgaṃ kartavyaṃ deśikena tudvitīyāvaraṇe devi kalā śaktyātmakāni tunādasyekakalā yāstu diśāsu vidiśāsu caeṣa te yāga ākhyāto durlabhastridaśairapieṣa sarvādayo yāgāḥ kathitāstava śobhanepraṇavaṃ hyāsanaṃ kṛtvā mātṛkāṃ tu yajedbudhaḥdakṣiṇe yojayedbījaṃ vāme yonintu vinyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: avargaṃ pūrvapatre tu kavargañcāgnigocaretavargaṃ paścime caiva pavargaṃ vāyugocareeṣa vai mātṛkāyāgaḥ kathitaṃ tava śobhaneevaṃ vargakrameṇaiva śivatatvantu mātṛkānrudroṅkāreṇa deveśi vidyātatvantu kārayetevante mātṛkāyāgo durlabhastridaśairapikathaṃ tasmin pradeśe ca śiṣyāssthāpyā maheśvarakṣatriyāṇāntu yatsthānaṃ vaiśyānāṃ vada śaṅkaragrahamedhi yathā kāryo dīkṣākāle maheśvaraśṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi niyogavidhimuttamamīśānyāṃ yatayasthāpyā viprāścottarataḥ sthitāḥvaiśyāḥ paścimadigbhāge śūdrā vai naiṛtena tuevaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhivat kuryādālabhanakriyāmtasya saṃskārayogo'yamatiruddhā samācaretgṛhasthaṃ śivavadbhāvaṃ tadbhāryāmagnikātanaudikpālaiḥ kulajān gṛhyāt śeṣānastragaṇānyasetsadārāpatyapatyānāṃ niyogaḥ parikīrtitaḥatraiva viniyuktasya striyāyānantu kārayetmahādoṣamavāpnoti caryāyuḥ paripālyategurutalpasamaṃ pāpaṃ hṛṣṭasaṃskārapāpakṛtpuṣpalātacitānasya kriyayoḥ paripūraṇamanena vidhinā devi doṣahīno bhavedguruḥgrahiṇāntu vidhāno'yaṃ kathitastava śobhanehomaḥ kāryastu deveśi ācāryeṇa mahātmanāśivamantrasya samayī mantratantrottaro bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tritatvaviniviṣṭastu mokṣayogyaḥ prajāyatepratyayāni yathā samyak aṇimādiguṇāṣṭakamviśokaḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra gatvā mṛtī bhavetsa dīkṣāṃ kartumarheta anyathā pāpakṛt bhavetagnisthānamupakramya karma nirvartayedguruḥsiddhāsiddhavibhāgajño varṇarūpahutāśanetasya mantrāḥ parā mūrtiḥ ādyaṃ vai somasaṃbhavamsaptajihvāvidhānajño homakarma samārabhetyathā dāharate karma tatsarvaṃ saphalaṃ bhavettuṣyate yajamānasya santuṣṭho vṛṣabhadhvajaḥekībhūtāstu tiṣṭhanti svalahavyendhanena tujvālāmālāsahasraistu pātālaṃ vadanaṃ smṛtamdevatārūpakañcaiva phalaṃ tasyaiva yādṛśamhomakāle prayatnena dve jihve parivarjayetdvitīyā yakṣadaivatyā tāmrākārasamaprabhāpañcamī viṣṇudevatyā atasīpuṣpasannibhāsaptamī bahudevatyā sarvarūpaistu dīpyatetṛtīyā praṇayetsarvāṃ jananaṃ sthāpya saṅgamānṣaṣṭhī tu sūryadevatyā ārogyaṃ sā prayacchatitasmātsarvaprayatnena madhye homaṃ praśasyatetasmātsarvaprayatnena dve jihve parivarjayetādityodayavarṇābhā snigdhavaiḍūryasannibhātaptāyasasavarṇābhā kusaṃbharasasannibhāḥindrāyudhasavarṇābhā indugopakasannibhāḥvidhūme lelihāne ca hotavyaṃ karmasiddhaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: snigdhaḥ pradakṣiṇāvartassarvakarmaphalapradaḥsaṃskārayogaḥ kartavyo yathāvattannibodhayeuccārya navatatvāni akāreṇa tu bheditānjaṅghe gulphe tathā pāde sarvatra viniyojayetnavātmanāhutiśataṃ svāhākāreṇa pātayetsānnidhyabandhanārthantu evaṃ bhavati śobhaneyojitavyaṃ śive paścāt putrako deśikena tugarbhādhānāditaḥ kṛtvā catvāriṃśāṣṭakaṃ kramātnikṣepoddhārayogādīn saṃskārāṃśca yathākramamnakārasaṃpuṭaṃ devi pakārokārayojitaḥśivena saha deveśi nātrakāryā vicāraṇāeṣa sarvavidhānantu śreṣṭhasarvaguṇottamamnissaṃśayakarañcaiva nirvāṇaphalasādhanamtena vijñātamātreṇa prāpnoti paramaṃ padamṣakāraṃ śatarudre tu daśadhā parikalpayetyogāṣṭake yakārastu suśiveraṃ prabhusmṛtaḥbhakārassaṃhitassādhye bakāraśśivasaṅkaredaśaghāte nakārastu pañcaśiṣye ca ya smṛtaḥśivabrahmapade tantu ṇakāro nandahemakevāgeśānte ṭhakārastu ṭakāraḥ pratipādhipaḥdhyānāhāre jhakāro vai vijñeyaṃ sādhakottamaiḥdhātāro vai dakāraśca ghakāraṃ bhasmamīśvarekakāro mūrtiraṣṭāsu oṣṭhānto rūpakaṃ viduḥoṅkāropyastramityuktamaiṅkāraṃ kavacaṃ viduḥhṛdayantu ḷ vijñeyaṃ ṛ sāvitrī nigadyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āsane u iti jñeyaṃ vijñeyaṃ ī ti karṇikāsadāśivaṃ vijānīyādakāraḥ paramaśśivaḥsa jñānāt sa śivassākṣāt sa yogī sa śivaṃ viduḥviṃśaviṃśatibhiścaiva pañcaviṃśatibhistathādīkṣākāryā tu mantrajñaḥ paśūnāñca yathecchayāpraśāntena dvayaṃ dadyāt tattu ekāhutiṃ hunetetadrahasyaṃ paramaṃ gopitaṃ na prakāśitamgurupriyāya dātavyaṃ śivabhaktiratāya caanyathā naiva dātavyaṃ dīkṣājñānamidaṃ śubhamviditvā jñānavijñānaṃ mocayenmucyateti cavarṇamantrapadenaiva kalayā ca caturvidhamjñānādhvā ca padādhvā ca varṇādhvā ca yathā punaḥeṣāmekadaśaṃ śodhyaṃ deśikena mahātmanāvasordhāraprayogena dātavyaṃ deśikena tutasmānmantrañca tatvañca mahimānañca śobhanebindunādalayañcaiva layātītaṃ paraṃ padamataḥ saṃkṣepato devi kathayāmi tavākhilamyatra yatra pradeśe tu pūjayitvā maheśvarambhuvanādhvā tu yaḥ prokto mayā tu tava suvṛtehomayettantravitprājñaḥ tatvamārgavicakṣaṇaḥsahasreṇa tu yudhyeta amanaskena śobhanesruvānupūraṇaṃ yāvattāvatkālaṃ samādiśetsarvamantramayaḥ proktaḥ sarvatatvamayastathāetaṃ hutvā tu pātavyaṃ pūrṇāhutyā tu śobhaneevaṃ hutvā mahādevi labhate śāśvataṃ śivam

sanskrit: anyāyā kathitā dīkṣā ekāhutyā tu śudhyatikiṃ punarbahudhā hutyā śudhyateti kimadbhutamata evaṃ punarvakṣye saṃkṣepaṃ śṛṇu suvratepūrṇāhutiśatenaiva śudhyate ca śivādhvareniṣkalena mayā khyātaṃ śūnyenaiva tathā punaḥakathyeyamidaṃ śuddhaṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥna cāsau deśikaḥ prokto na ca yojyaḥ śivādhvareyasmin pratiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sa carācaramsa jñeyassakalo devo varṇarūpadharaḥ prabhuḥpītasvacchakapotañca śabalaṃ karburaṃ tathāsarvāyudhadharaṃ śaṃbhuṃ jaṭābhāravibhūṣitamsarvasiddhikaraṃ devaṃ sādhakānāṃ na saṃśayaḥgulikākāśagamane dantakāṣṭhaparitrakesarvaṃ saṃpadyate samyak japataḥ sakalaṃ priyepūjayetsakalaṃ devaṃ japetsakalaniṣkalampūjayecchakalaṃ devaṃ śiraḥ pāṇyādibhiryutamjapakāle sadā devaṃ kuryācchakalaniṣkalamdhyāyejjyotirmayaṃ sūkṣmaṃ raktaṃ pītaṃ sitāsitamtarpaṇe sarvamantrāṇāṃ svāhākārasamanvitamhuṃkāraḥ phaṭkṛtaścaiva dvirabhyastaṃ bhavedivasvāhākāre yadābhinno pratiṣṭhā nāma sā kalāvidyābindusamāyuktā śāntistu sa visargataḥsādhakānāṃ hitārthāya śivena kathitaṃ purāuccāṭane ca vidveṣastaṃbhane ca prayojayetpañcatatvamayaṃ devaṃ sarvatatvamayaṃ tathā

sanskrit: yasmin yasmiṃśca deveśi jñāyate su parisphuṭamsaptatatvaparaṃ devi tatvamekādaśa prabhumṣaṭtriṃśātmā tu vijñeyaṃ kalātatvaṃ sa eva tumantrātmā tu sa vijñeyo bhuvanādhvā sa eva tuṣaṭtriṃśakassavijñeyaḥ īśvaraḥ parameśvaraḥpañcarātraṃ tu tatvajñaiḥ sa eva parikīrtitaḥbauddhaścārhatāścaiva nyāyavaiśeṣikāstathāsa eva kathito haṃsaḥ sakalaḥ parameśvariśaktinādārdhacandraśca bindudevastathaiva caeṣa dehe samākhyātaḥ sakalasya vinirṇayaḥkathayeddevadevasya tannibodha samāsataḥukārastu tṛtīyastu makārastu caturthakamebhirvaṇairyadā hīnaṃ niṣkalaṃ parameśvaramta ete saṃsthitaikastho hukāraḥ parikīrtitaḥyadā bindugato śaṃbhuḥ nāsikāyāṃ pravartatenābhivarṇairyadā hīnaṃ tadā śūnyaṃ vinirdiśetakāraḥ kathito devi bindunādapare sthitaḥśaktyātītaṃ yadā devi kiñciccheṣamavasthitamsakalānugraheṇaiva kathitaṃ tava śobhaneeṣa devi samākhyāto dehe yasmātpratiṣṭhitādehayuktastu deveśe sakalaḥ paripaṭhyateīkārasahasaṃyuktaṃ dehaṃ tasya varānanekathitaṃ pūrvasūtre tu tattvayā viditaṃ purāniṣkalassa samākhyāto veditavyaḥ suśobhaneātmajñānena saṃyukto gacchate sa sadāśive
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vyāpinyā tu yadāyuktaṃ ṣaḍvarṇarahitaśśivaḥasaṃkhyānañca sūryāṇāṃ uditoditasuprabhamtatsthāne tu yadāhyātmā tadrūpaḥ pratibhāti saḥtasyāṃ madhye tadāhyātmā tadrūpaḥ pratibhāti saḥtasmiṃsthāne tadāhyātmā tadrūpapratimo bhavetcandrātapapratīkāśā amṛtaṃ sravate sadātatsthāne tu tadāhyātmā tadrūpaḥ pratibhāti saḥebhirvarṇairyadāhīnaṃ ṣaḍvarṇarahitaśśivaḥṣaṭpadārthamidaṃ jñānaṃ kathitaṃ parameṣṭhināyena yena ca te tattat bhāvābhāvamavāpnuyātyadyadrūpeṇa saṃyujyet tadrūpaṃ pratibhāti catasmātkaraṇasaṃyukto badhyate mucyateti cajñānena tallayaṃ jñeyaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvagato bhavetjñātvā hyātmā vinirdiṣṭo jñānajñeyaṃ sa jānateevante jñānamākhyātaṃ ṣaḍvarṇaṃ parameśvarina tasya śakyate vaktuṃ pāraṃparyeṇa saṃsthitamjñānavijñānavān so hi mocakassa gurussadābrahmādayasmṛtāste tu ye rūpāḥ kathitā mayāetaddevi mayā khyātaṃ tatvaṃ paramadurlabhamsakalaṃ niṣkalañcaiva tathā sakalaniṣkalambindudevaṃ paraṃ tatvaṃ jñeyaṃ sakalaniṣkalamātmatatve trayo devā vidyātatve tathaiva caśaktistu paramā devi tritatvaparamā sthitātasmāt sarvamidaṃ devi tato sarvamidaṃ tatamvyāptirbahuvidhā proktā samayā nāvadhāritā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvatatvamayañcaiva sarvabhūtamayaṃ kathamṣoḍaśāvayavātmānaṃ ekaviṃśātmakaṃ kathammātṛkātmeti yatproktaṃ ekāśīti padātmakampañcaviṃśasavijñeyaḥ ṣaḍviṃśakastathaiva capāñcarātrikatatvajñaḥ sa eva paramaṃ padamsarveṣu saṃsthitaṃ devaṃ sakalaḥ parameśvaraḥitihāsapurāṇajñā dharmaśāstraratāśca yesevante devadeveśaṃ sakalaṃ parameśvaramsarvametadaśeṣantu vistareṇa bravīhi meśṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi sakalasya vinirṇayampañcadevamayaṃ devi brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥpañcadevā smṛtā hyete sarvataḥ paryavasthitāḥūkāraṃ viṣṇudevatyaṃ bindudevaṃ tatheśvaramsakalaṃ niṣkalañcaiva kalāḍhyaṃ śūnyameva caete bhūtāssamākhyātāḥ karaṇaiḥ sahasaṃyutāḥguṇatrayaṃ tathā devi bhūtātmakamidaṃ smṛtambhūtaiḥ parivṛtā yasmin karaṇāśeṣaśobhanevidyāceśvaramāyā ca kālo niyatireva caīśvarastu śiraścaiva vidyādakṣiṇarekhiṇīniyatiḥ kālo'dhastāttu boddhavyamanupūrvaśaḥsaptatatvadharaṃ devameṣa te samudāhṛtamśṛṇuṣvāvahitā devi kathayāmi tavākhilamupariṣṭācchivaṃ tatva mūrdhvaśaktipratiṣṭhitamṣoḍaśāvayavātmānaṃ yaduktaṃ hi mayā purātṛṭirlavaṃ nimeṣastu kalākāṣṭhā muhūrtatā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yugaṃ manvantaraṃ kalpaṃ mahākalpastathaiva caṣaṭtriṃśātmeti yatproktaṃ śṛṇu tasya vadāmyahamcaturviṃśati tatvaṃ hi puruṣaṃ pañcaviṃśakamaṣṭāviṃśa smṛtaṃ rāgaṃ vidyā jñeyā tathā parātriṃśatastu kalātatvaṃ kathitaṃ hi śivena tudvātriṃśakasmṛtā vidyā trayastriṃśādhikeśvaramśivaṣṣaṭtriṃśamākhyātā śivena paramātmanākalā caturthī sā jñeyā deśikena mahātmanāsadyā kalābhiraṣṭābhiḥ vāmadevastrayodaśamīśānaṃ pañcadhā devi tasya dehādvinissṛtāḥbindudeve ca catvāraḥ kalā devi vadāmyahamkalāhyetāstu catvāraḥ sa eva parameśvaraḥsūkṣmāsūkṣmatarairbhāvaiḥ sakalaḥ parameśvaraḥmātṛkātmeti yatproktaṃ mayā te surasundarisa kāmasya tu deveśi deho jñeyāssadā budhaiḥekāśīti padātme tu yaduktaṃ parameśvarimantrātmā tu kriyā proktaḥ sa eva parameśvaraḥtābhyo bindudvayamante tābhyāṃ te alikadvayamdvitīyā bindvadhastāttu mantrātmā sa tu kīrtitaḥtena sarvamidaṃ devi trailokyaṃ sa carācaramtiryaṅmṛganarākhyānāṃ sa jīvaḥ parikīrtitaḥsarveṣāmeva mantrāṇāṃ kathitaṃ tava śobhanesaṃjñeyassarvamantreṣu sarvatantreṣu śobhaneeṣa te jñānasadbhāvaṃ mantrasadbhāva eva cagopitavyaṃ prayatnena jñānametatsudurlabham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: naiva mantrāḥ prasidhyanti japtāḥ koṭiśatairapisubhāṣitamidaṃ vākyaṃ kalānārhanti ṣoḍaśīsarvasvaṃ gopitaṃ jñātaṃ na khyātaṃ yasya kasyacitsarvatantravidhijñāya sādhakāya ca dhīmateanyāyai gṛhyate ye tu nābhinandanti ye gurumtasmāt jñānaṃ guruñcaiva a * * * * *? vṛtevibhaktiñcaiva kurvīta parameśena bhāṣitamviditvā sarvakarmāṇi kuru devi yathecchayānātaḥ parataraṃ jñānaṃ satyaṃ devi vadāmyahamtatpravakṣyāmyahaṃ devi saṃkṣepānna tu vistarātte mayā pūrvamākhyātaṃ yathā tu viditaṃ tvayābrahmā tatrādhipatyena saṃsthitaṃ parameśvariviṣṇustatvādhipatyena saṃsthitaṃ parameśvarirudrastatvādhipatyena saṃsthitaḥ parameśvaraḥīśvara ādhipatyena saṃsthito nātra saṃśayaḥvyāpinaṃ pañcadhā devi bhuvanādhvamaśeṣataḥtadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tadekāgramanā śṛṇupṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva catanmātrāṇi tathā pañca katitaṃ tava śobhanecaturviṃśat smṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ kṣetrajñaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥvyaktāvyaktavijñānāt jñātvā kucyati bandhanātjñasvabhāvo bhavedātmā puruṣaṃ pañcaviṃśakamniṣkriyaṃ tatsvabhāvena akartā karmaṇaḥ prabhuḥevaṃ vadanti deveśi ṣaṣṭitantrādhvavādinaḥviṣayendriyatanmātraiḥ guṇādividhivācakaiḥ

sanskrit: bhoktā tu puruṣaḥ proktaḥ cinmātro guṇavarjitaḥniṣkalatvena manyante sarvajñaṃ sarvatomukhamityetatpauruṣaṃ tatvaṃ sāṃkhyānāṃ paramaṃ padamyairbaddhaḥ paśutānaiti ajñatvañca prajāyatearthitvaṃ pāratantrañca dharmāṣṣaṭ pauruṣāstvimeniṣkrayatvādudāsīno akartā ajñatā punaḥdharmāhyete smṛtāstasya mātṛkaiḥ pratipāditāḥniṣkalatvaṃ na tasyaiva śaktyāgrakalanā śrutaḥkiñcitkālaṃ bhavenmuktiḥ pradhānaguṇabandhanātrogamānandabhāvena vidyāhyarthavivekinīmāyātmakamidaṃ devi adhobhāgapravartakamsakalaṃ vyāpayitvā tu saṃsthitaṃ tantu suvratetadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tadekāgramanāḥ śṛṇunarāṇāṃ nayane sūkṣme yogī nārāyaṇeśvaraḥsa caiva paṭhyate taistu ṣaḍūrmirahitā tanuḥasminneva śṛṇu devi ṣaḍūrmirahitaṃ yathāśaktinā rahitaṃ devi ṣaḍūrmirahitaṃ śivamneti neti ca haṃsākhyaṃ paramaṃ brahmavācakamidaṃ sā paramāmuktiḥ yā sā vedavido dhruvamātmānamantarātmānaṃ paramātmānameva cabuddhimanye tathā devi pradhānaguṇagocarambaddhā vadanti bahavaḥ ṛṣayassaṃśitavratāḥṛṣayo yakṣarakṣāṃsi piśācoragakinnarāḥsiddhāścaiva tathā devi ye cānye bhuvi mānavāḥsthūlātsthūlataraṃ devaṃ kalpayanti manīṣiṇaḥ

sanskrit: haritaṃ kapilañcaiva mañjiṣṭhaḥ sagareva caśyāmaṃ tadulamāntrantu āpabaddhe ca puṣkarecandrabiṃbanibhaṃ kecit ādityodayasannibhamevaṃ bahuvidhaṃ deva sakalaṃ parameśvariasmātprabhūyate sarvamasminneva layaṃ punaḥuttiṣṭhamāditaḥ kṛtvā vidveṣākarṣaṇaṃ tathākiṃ tasya bahubhirmantraiḥ jñātaistu varavarṇinīyāge yāge jape home yathā sidhyanti yoginaḥyāgasthaṃ sakalaṃ devaṃ śiraḥ pāṇyādilakṣaṇamevaṃ japaṃ tathā dhyāyan pūjayetparameśvaramcintyamānasya deveśe sarvavighnakṣayo bhavetyogakāle tathā devi dhyātavyaṃ sakalaṃ priyebindusthaṃ śabdalīnantu jyotīrūpaṃ śikhānvitamjapakāle japaṃ kuryāt evaṃ sakalaniṣkalambindudvayātparo devi sa vai niṣkalamucyatesvāhākāra samāyuktaṃ homakāle tu homayettayā homavikalpastu kartavyantu sadā budhaiḥśāntyarthe vauṣaḍityevaṃ puṣṭyarthe namasuvauṣaṭmāraṇe tāḍane caiva icchā devi vicakṣaṇamevaṃ vijñāya kartavyaṃ japayogaṃ samādhināsakalaṃ japamānastu niṣkalaṃ japitaṃ bhavetacirāddevi siddhyeta parameśena bhāṣitamkathitaṃ sa rahasyantu na mayā gopitaṃ tavaanyāye pṛcchate yastu guruvutkrāntigocaramdharmaśīlavinītasya gurubhaktasya dhīmate

sanskrit: tasmācchreyārthibhirnityaṃ pūjanīyo gurussadātithinakṣatrayogāśca itarānukūlameva capūrveṇa brahmaṇe kuryāt kṣatriyasyottareṇa tubrāhmaṇe madhurāsvādā kaṣāyā kṣatriyasya tuājyagandhādvije bhūmīraktagandhā tu kṣatriyeparīkṣya nipuṇo bhūmiṃ vārayogavidhānavithorāddrekkāṇi aṃśāśca tārā caiva balābalamyadi syāllaukiko devi kālajñānaṃ na jānatitatassaṃpūjya deveśaṃ lakṣayecca kramādbudhaḥlakṣayitvā vidhānena ācāryassusamāhitaḥgītavādyaravodghoṣaṃ jayaśabdasamanvitambhaumānyetāni śabdāni antarikṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥsnigdhavidyullatāramyaṃ sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ śubhamkākavṛddhacalolūkaśvānamārjārakūjitameteṣāñcaiva yaśśabda praśastantu śobhanekhātayejjānumātrantu pāṃsumuddhṛtya pūrayetjñātvā bhūmirvidhānajño vāstuyāgaṃ yajedbudhaḥvāstuyāga smṛto hyeṣaḥ tato bhūmyāṃ viśodhanamsecayetpañcagavyena tāṃ bhūmiṃ suparīkṣitāmkoṣṭayet sudṛḍhāṃ bhūmiṃ nimnonnatavivarjitāmsamaṃ sarvatra kartavyaṃ bhūmibhāgamidaṃ śubhampuruṣāyā na kartavyamiṣṭakaṃ mṛṇmayañca vāevaṃ kṛtvā tato devi viṣṇubhūmiparigrahampañcāṅgañca śivaṃ yaṣṭvā juhuyādaṣṭaśataṃ kramātpīṭhoṅkārasamāyuktaṃ pūjayeta gaṇeśvaram

sanskrit: bhūmyāṃ parigrahohyeṣa kathitaṃ tava śobhanesaṃbhāraiḥ saṃbhṛto mantrī adhivāsanamārabhetevaṃ vinyasya yatnena śivākhyaṃ kalaśaṃ nyasetathavā mṛṇmayaṃ vāpi kārayeta vicakṣaṇaḥsu sugandhaistathā gandhaiḥ kaṇṭhasūtravibhūṣitamāsanaṃ kalpayettatra īśānyādiśamāśritampañcabrahmā nyasetpūrvaṃ aṣṭattriṃśatkalāṃ tataḥevaṃ vinyasya tatvāni tritatvāṃstu tridhā nyasetevaṃ vinyasya yatnena śivasyāvāhanaṃ kuruaghoreṇa tu sānnidhyamarghyaṃ tatpuruṣeṇa tuhṛdaye hṛdayaṃ dadyāt śiraḥ śirasi vinyasetastraṃ hastapradeśe tu vinyasya parameśvarimantrātītaṃ paraṃ devaṃ tatvātītaṃ paraṃ padamastraṃ japtvā tato devi vikirān sarvato diśigandhodakena saṃśodhya kalaśaṃ bhrāmayettataḥacchinnodakadhārāntu dadyāt bāhye tu mantravitvardhanīmagrato gacchet kalaśaṃ tasya pṛṣṭataḥbhrāmayitvā tato devi punastatraiva sthāpayetsthaṇḍilantu tato gacchet vidhinā pūjayettataḥāgneyyāṃ diśi āśritya agnikuṇḍantu kārayetcaturaṅgulamekaikā hrasvā hrasvatarā smṛtāḥullekhanantu tenaiva uddhṛtyābhyukṣayet punaḥupalepite tu paścāt kuryādrekhopakalpanamekā uttarataḥ kāryā dakṣiṇāyatamuttarāviṣṭaraṃ kuṇḍamadhye tu vāgīśvaryāḥ prakalpayet

sanskrit: tasmin tato mantrī ṛtumatīṃ vicintayetabhyarcya pañcabhirmantraiḥ vidyāṅgaiśca yathākramamtridhā kuṇḍantu taṃ bhrāmya hṛdayena vidhānavitgarbhādhānaṃ pratimantrī sadyena tu tridhā hutiḥarghyaṃ pādyaṃ tato dadyāt garbhādhānaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavetrudrāṇyā tu trayaṃ dadyāt kṛtaṃ puṃsuvanaṃ bhavettrayo brahmaśireṇaiva arghyaṃ pādyaṃ tataḥ punaḥvaktrodghāṭantu kuryādānupūrveṇa mantravitekenaiva tu mantreṇa juhuyānnatra saṃśayaḥāhutīnāṃ trayaṃ dadyāt vaktre vaktre na saṃśayaḥudghāṭite tato vaktre jātakarmantu homayetastreṇaiva trayaṃ dadyāt āhutīnāṃ varānanejātakarma kṛte paścāt rakṣāṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥdakṣiṇe rudradevatyaṃ kalpayedviṣṭaropariuttareṇa śivasyaiva kalpayeta yathākramamīśānena tu hotavyaṃ nāmakarma vicakṣaṇaḥhutvā hyevaṃ tato devī śivāgnirjanito bhavetsaṃskāreṇa yadā śuddhaṃ agnimāhutya suvṛtesāṅgena devadevena pañcabrahmayutena catritatvaṃ vinyaset pūrvaṃ śivaṃ tattvāttu vinyasetyavagodhūmanīvāraiśśāliṣaṣṭikataṇḍalaiḥmadhyamaṃ pākasaṃyuktaṃ pācayeta vicakṣaṇaḥcālanaṃ ghaṭṭanālepaṃ kuryādekādaśena tuekādaśātmadevena juhuyādāhutitrayamvibhāgabhājitaṃ kṛtvā carukaṃ mantrasaṃskṛtam

sanskrit: tṛtīyaṃ sādhakebhyaśca pañcagavyapurassaramgomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhisarpiḥ kuśodakampañcagavyantu kartavyaṃ vidhinā'nena suvṛteājyādhiśrayaṇaṃ kuryādudvāsyoplavanaṃ tataḥnīrāyaṇaṃ tataḥ kuryāt ājyaśuddhiṃ vidhānavitsaṃskāraiśśodhite ājye ājyabhāgantu homayetājyabhāgavibhāgantu kathitaṃ tava śobhaneājyaśuddhividhirhyeṣaḥ kathitantu yathākramamsadyādi īśaparyantamekaikāhutayo hunetanena sarvakarmāṇi kartavyāni tu deśikaiḥudvāsane tu gāyatrī utplavane viṣṇudaivatamavadyotasvaro jñeyo deśikena mahātmanāabhimantrya samantraistu śivaṃ tatraiva cintayetkarmamantraprayogena adhidevaiśca saṃyutamāsanaṃ kalpayettatra vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇāanantaṃ vinyasetpūrvaṃ dharmajñānaṃ tathaiva caakāraṃ vinyaseddevi karṇikāyāṃ varānanehrasvoṅkārasamāyuktaṃ somamaṇḍalakalpitamākāraṃ brahmadevatyamādityasyādhidaivatamukāraṃ rudradaivatyamagnimaṇḍaladaivatamīśvareṇa samāyuktaṃ vinyaseta varānanenyasyā tu devadeveśi pañcabrahmāṇi vinyasetātmatatve tu vaktavyamātmā tu parameśvarivāmadevena sadyena lakṣamātraṃ prakīrtitamaṅgapratyaṅgasaṃyuktaṃ kartavyaṃ susamāhitaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcamūrdhānamīśena pūrvādārabhya mantrataḥvaktre tatpuruṣasyaiva kalāni parikalpayetaghorasya kalāṃ devi hṛdayādivinirdiśetpṛṣṭhehyurasi mantrajña aghorasya kalā nyasetgude caiva tu liṅge ca ūrubhyāṃ jānunī tathāguhyāṅgakramayogena vāmadevakalā nyasetsadyojātakalā devi sadyaḥ sarvatra mūrtiṣutatvānyaṣṭādaśaṃ devi navatatvānyathāpi vāpañcatatvāni vinyasya tritatvamupari nyasetāvāhite tato devi aṅgāni parikalpayetśikhāyāntu śikhāṃ dadyāt kavacaṃ sarvagātrakamāvāhayeta sadyena vāmadevena sthāpayetīśānena tu puṣpāṇi makuṭaṃ kuṇḍalāni caaghoraṃ dakṣiṇenaiva vāmadevaṃ tathottareāgneyyāṃ hṛdayañcaiva īśānyāntu śiro nyasetastraṃ dvārapradeśe tu vinyaseta yathā budhaḥanantaṃ pūrvato dadyāt sūkṣmaṃ dakṣiṇato nyasetekanetrottareṇaiva vinyaseta sadā budhaḥśrīkaṇṭhaṃ naiṛtenaiva śikhaṇḍiṃ vāyugocaretṛtīyāvaraṇaṃ devi śṛṇuṣva kathayāmi teevaṃ vinyasya yatnena caturthe'strāṇi vinyasetpūrvoktena vidhānena kurvīta vidhivistarampañcāṅgena samāyuktamardhacandrapurottaresamayāṣṭakadoṣasya kṛtaṃ homaṃ mayā tavasamayāṣṭakadoṣeṇa sādhakenaiva lipyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūjayettadguruṃ prājño yathā vibhavavistaraiḥkarṇikākaṭakeyūraiḥ pūjayeta sadā gurumnivedayettadātmānaṃ tadā tu ninṛṇo bhavetṣaḍvidhaṃ yajate yastu ācāryaḥ susamāhitaḥśivavatpūjayeddevi ācāryaṃ tatvapāragamveditavyaṃ prayatnena sādhakaistatvacintakaiḥśarīre tāni sarvāṇi jñātavyāni vipaścitaiḥnāsāṃ sañcārayogaṃ vai jñātavyaṃ tatvavedibhiḥsañcāraṃ hyeṣa tatvānāṃ bhoktā bhojyaṃ tathaiva cajñātvā sarvamaśeṣeṇa sādhakassavidhīyatevijñeyassa sadā tajjño uttarāyaṇamuttamamdakṣiṇāyanamityeva kathitaṃ tava suvṛteviṣuvaṃ sa tu vijñeyaṃ yogakālaḥ prakīrtitaḥādityaḥ sa tu vijñeyo jyeṣṭhā śaktiḥ prakīrtitāsāṃgratsthānaṃ sa vijñeyaṃ dakṣiṇena vyavasthitaḥsomasya tu sa tu jñeyo vāmā śaktiḥ prakīrtitāsvapnasthānaṃ sa vijñeyaṃ vāmatastu vyavasthitamraudrī tantu vijānīyādicchāśaktiḥ prakīrtitāḥtāmasantu vijānīyāt madhyame tu vyavasthitambhūtaṃ brahma vijānīyāt bhaviṣyaṃ vaiṣṇave padetrikālamekato devi bindudevaṃ vyavasthitamtasyātītaṃ bhavonnādaṃ devadevaṃ sadāśivampañcadhā pañcadevatyaṃ sakalaṃ vyāpya saṃsthitambrahmāṇamādhipatyena veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥjñātavyaṃ hi tatvajñaiḥ viṣṇustatrādhidaivatam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vijñeyaṃ tatsadā tajjñaiḥ rudrastatrādhidaivatamjñātavyantu varārohe īśastatrādhidaivatametatsarvamaśeṣeṇa jñātavyaṃ deśikena tujñātvā sarvamaśeṣeṇa ācāryassa vidhīyatevidyā rudrassamākhyātaḥ śāntirīśvara ucyatenādasyaiva krameṇaiva devatā kathitā mayā*? nāstu pañcamo jñeyo niṣkalastu sadāśivaḥsūkṣmānyāyena mayā proktā devatā te prakīrtitāḥjñātavyaṃ tatvato devi sādhakena mahātmanāsañcāraṃ kurute devi sa tu ātmā vijānataḥtasmiṃstaistu samāyuktasañcaret parameśvaraḥiṣṭasetsarvabhūteṣu tatvairyukto na saṃśayaḥaviditvā na sidhyeta na ca yāti paraṃ padambhagavan śrotumicchāmi bhoktā bhojyañca śaṅkarako vā kṣipati garbhe tu grāsaṃ gṛhṇāti kaḥ prabhoetatsarvamaśeṣeṇa kathayasva prasādataḥyena vijñātamātreṇa annadoṣe na lipyateannaṃ brahmā raso viṣṇurbhoktā devo maheśvaraḥyo vijānāti kartāraṃ bhoktā bhojyañca he priyetatvāni manasā cintya svaśarīre yathākramamdakṣiṇe śravaṇe caiva khamalaḥ parikīrtitaḥsakalaṃ niṣkalañcaiva nāsāyāṃ parikalpayetśūnyena paśyate cānnaṃ veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥbrahmā ca viṣṇuśśravaṇe rudramīśvaracakṣuṣīnāsāśaktiṃ vijānīyādvaktre devaṃ sadāśivam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ tatvamayaṃ dhyātvā śivaṃ paramakāraṇamṣaṇmukhenaiva yāgena bhuñjate satataṃ prabhuḥkhaṇḍakhādyaiśca bhuñjānaḥ kṣapaṇe gṛhṇate sadāūrdhvamutkṣipate grāsanna vidyātkhamalaṃ kṛtamśūnyenaiva annādya granthete satataṃ punaḥlehyaṃ śoṣyañca peyañca annāni vividhāni caevaṃ tatvamayaṃ divyamācāryacchinnasaṃśayaḥatha tatvavidaścaiva evaṃ bhuñjate priyeatatvapratibuddhasya jñānine koṭirucyatedvijānāṃ vedaviduṣāṃ koṭiṃ saṃbhojya yatphalambhojyaṃ māyātmakaṃ sarvaṃ kartā devo maheśvaraḥevaṃ vai yo vijānāti deśikastatvapāragaḥevaṃ bhojyavidhiṃ samyak na tu sarvatra vyāpayetevaṃ vai yo vijānīyādajñānīcānyathā bhavetūrdhvena vahate prāṇa āpānodhaḥ pravartatetena bhuktena deveśe dātaroḍasya kulāni tutadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi bhagavan vaktumarhasipuryaṣṭake yadāhyātmā vāyubhūto vyavasthitaḥśrūyate yātanā tasya narakeṣu anekadhātanubhūtaśśarīrātmā bhogān bhuñjati śaṅkaraśṛṇu devi idaṃ guhyaṃ kathayāmi tavākhilambhuñjate pūjitaṃ karma kathayāmi maheśvaripuryaṣṭake yadāhyātmā vāyubhūto vyavasthitaḥtridhāntaḥ karaṇaṃ devi tairna mucyetkṣaṇādapitiṣṭhantamanutiṣṭheta dhāvantamanudhāvati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taistu yuktaṃ punardehaṃ saṃprapadye varānaneakasmājjāyate dehaṃ kṣaṇamātreṇa śobhanebhūtātmakaṃ tadā dehaṃ jāyate paramāṇubhiḥtārādyaṃ jñānajaṃ vāpi akṛtādyādidehajamnarake ca varārohe yātanā tu pṛthagvidhābrahmaviṣṇvātmakā bhūtā rudrātmā īśvarātmakāḥviṣayāścaiva teṣveva jñātavyāni varānanetasmāttu devadeveśe nyaseddevi sadāśivesanyāsa eṣa vikhyātaḥ śivena paramātmanābrahmāṇamāditaḥ kṛtvā devaiśca sahasaṃyutaḥpūrvamādikrameṇaiva śabdādīnāṃ yathākramamevaṃ hute śate devi pūrṇāhutyā tu pātayetrasaṃ vai vinyasedviṣṇoḥ rūpaṃ gandhastathaiva caahaṅkārastathā buddhirīśvare tantu vinyasetnyaste puryaṣṭake devi pūrṇāhutyā tu pātayetpūrṇāhutyā tu deveśi pātayet susamāhitaḥsadāśivasya tatvasya nidhanena tu homayetsakalādikrameṇaiva grāhakāḥ parikīrtitāḥdīkṣā pañcavidhā devi kathitā tu samāsataḥtatra śudhyenna śudhyeta viśeṣaḥ kathito mayāsamayabhede hetvarthe antyeṣṭintu samārabhetevaṃ saṃhārayogena huneccaiva yathākramamsamayācāradoṣasya pramādātskhalitasya caathavā mātṛkādhvānaṃ kṣakārādi samāsataḥekaikena tu varṇena homayeta vicakṣaṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tena pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyādantyeṣṭintu samarpayetantyeṣṭiḥ śudhyate caiva prāyaścittādviśudhyatesarvājñā laṅghane caiva antyeṣṭi homayettataḥkālacakravidhānajñaḥ kālajñassa vidhīyatekasmātpravartate kālaḥ kathaṃ kālo nigadyateyena sañcodyamānastu kālaḥ kalayate prabholaukikādhyātmikañcaiva kathaṃ vijñāyate prabhovināvināvayaścaiva muhūrtānāṃ tathaiva caghaṭikānāṃ samākhyā hi tatvānāñca yathākramamlaukikādhyātmikañcaiva kathayasva prasādataḥtadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yatsurairapi durlabhamyathā vai jñāyate devi laukikaṃ kālamuttamametatkālavidhānajño labhate śāśvataṃ padamlaukikādhyātmikaṃ kālaṃ yo vetti nikhilena tuśubhāśubhañca deveśe lokasyaiva hitāhitamkālacakraṃ samākhyātamādityāt saṃpravartateṛturmāsastathā pakṣo gṛhaṛkṣātharāśayaḥaṃśāssandhyastathā tārā horāddrekkāṇayastathāsa eṣa kathitaḥ kālaḥ laukikaḥ parameśvaritathā te kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvāyatalocanebhāskareṇa samāssarve rāśayaśca na saṃśayaḥgrahān patreṣu saṃsthāpya pūrvādidalasaṃsthitāngṛhacakraṃ smṛto hyeṣa jñātavyaṃ kālavedinārajaputraṃ nyaseddevi dakṣiṇe susamāhitaḥbṛhaspatiṃ nyasennityaṃ paścime susamāhitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ketumīśānasthāpya tato mantrāḥ prakalpayetsakalaṃ niṣkalañcaiva śūnyatatvaṃ tathaiva cakaṇṭhoṣṭhyañcaiva deveśe gṛhāhyete prakīrtitāḥparākṣaraṃ paraṃ devaṃ brahmasthānena vinyasetkarṇike devatānyāsaṃ kartavyaṃ kālavedināsakalādikrameṇaiva kathayāmi samāsataḥete prāṇā smṛtā devi vibhajeta yathākramamśatāni saptavijñeyamekaikasya varānanepatre patre tu saṃsthāpya gṛhān sarvān varānanedīptāṅgāriṇi dhūmā ca sthānatrayamudāhṛtamātmanā saha saṃyuktaḥ karṇikāsthaḥ prabhu smṛtaḥraudramāgneyadigbhāge śāntiṃ vai dakṣiṇena tuvāyavyāṃ kṣipranāśāya dhanalābhāya cottareśāntike pauṣṭike caiva evamādikrameṇa tuaśubhamekataḥ proktaṃ dvitīyasmin śubhaṃ vadettadgṛhaṃ pūjayennityaṃ karṇikāsthaṃ yadā budhaḥekaikasya gṛho devi horātrāṇi prakīrtitāḥekaikasya tu horāyāṃ śatāni navasaṃkhyayāetatte cāramākhyātaṃ śivena paramātmanāgṛhahorabalenaiva vaktavyantu śubhāśubhamevaṃ balābalaṃ jñātvā ātmanasya parasya vādehasthaṃ kathitaṃ devi horacāramanuttamamrāśau rāśau yadāhyātmā carate kathayāmyahamakāraḥ prathamo devi meṣarāśiḥ prakīrtitaḥtatrasthaścarate hyātmā yathāvattannibodhame
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: eṣa cāraḥ samākhyātaḥ rāśau rāśau na saṃśayaḥyatpatre paśyate doṣaṃ tanmāse doṣamādiśetkṣemamārogyārthalābhaṃ vadate kālayogavittadrekkāṇe nave rāśau cāraṃ teṣāṃ dadāmyahamekaikodayasthāvajñaḥ sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥuttiṣṭhe cādadhāne ca pādalepe'ñjane tathāgṛhoparāgavanmāse hṛtpadme tu sa paśyatiśubhāśubhantu drekkāṇaiḥ kathayeta varānaneaṃśādrekkāṇahoraiśca ekaikasya samāsataḥtāracandrabalenaiva śubhāśubhaṃ na saṃśayaḥvadate yoginaḥ śrīmān lokasyaiva hitāhitamsahasradvayaṃ vijñeyaṃ śatāni catureva tutārāṇāṃ yāvatī saṃkhyā aṃśānāṃ tāvatī smṛtāḥjñānena mucyate devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇāātmā tu kathitaḥ kāla īśvarassa tu kathyateataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kālacakramanuttamamtadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yāthātathyena me śṛṇukalā tu devadeveśe ṣoḍaśaiva tu vinyasettathā cakradhṛtikarī saumarī cicchubhaṃ tathādaśapañca kalā jñeyā amṛtā caiva ṣoḍaśījvālinī tu śamā dhūmrā kāmadā vijayā tathātālujihvopajihvā ca tathā jihvāvahā ca yāṣoḍaśaitāssamākhyātāḥ marutādiralaṅkṛtāvepathussaṃbhramaścaiva vibhramo bhrama eva caṛṣayo nāgakūrmaśca ṣoḍaśaite mahānilāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bibhajya kathayetprāṇān kalādīnāṃ yathākramamśatatrayañca jñātavyaṃ prāṇāḥ pañcāśadeva tuekodayena jñātavyaṃ deśikena mahātmanāataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi ṛkṣeṣu camare yathāśatāni sapta vijñeyāḥ * *? prāṇāstathaiva calavamekañca jñātavyaṃ kālajñena mahātmanāaṃśādhvā daśamākhyātā ṛkṣāṇāṃ varavarṇinīebhyaścarati ātmā tu kathayāmi samāsataḥyathā carati viśvātmā śṛṇuṣva kathayāmi teprāṇā dvādaśa vijñeyā nimeṣadvaya saṃyutamdvā navati śataikantu prāṇasaṃkhyā prakīrtitāḥtṛṭe śṛṅgāgramākhyātaṃ jñātavyaṃ susamāhitaiḥaśīti caturaṃśantu sarvatra parikīrtitamkṛttikādiṣu ratneṣu jñātavyaṃ kālavedināyasyai tacchubhaṛkṣeṇa vīcāyāṃ vrajate naraḥna tasya aśubhaṃ kiñcit vyābhīcyāṃ vrajate tu yaḥahorātreṇa jñātavyaṃ kālajñena mahātmanādine dine sthiredyastu idaṃ cakraṃ samādhinānaiva puṇyaṃ bhavettasya naiva pāpaṃ kathañcanaataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi phalasaṃkhyā yathaiva caviduṣāṇi tathā ṣaṣṭiṃ bindurekaṃ pracakṣatephalasya eṣā saṃkhyoktā kālaṃ vai laukikasya tutaruṇasya pradhānasya niruddhaḥ prāṇinaḥ sa tuṣaṣṭimirvī nāḍyekā ghaṭikā kathitā tu sāmuhūrtā striṃśadākhyātā ahorātravido viduḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00279 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kavāṭasaṅkulaścaiva krimivaitaraṇī tathāvakranāśaśca vividhaḥ khañjarīṭakameva caśivānādaṃ gajanādaṃ mahānādaṃ tathaiva camūṣikaṃ ghorarūpañca kṛṣṇavartamadhaḥ śiraḥikṣu yantrañca aśani tathā gaṇḍodara smṛtaḥeteṣāṃ bhuvanā raudrā strikoṇāḥ parikīrtitāḥmanonmanassamākhyātastathā ca sumanonmanaḥrāgatatvasamākhyātaśśodhanīyā vidurbadhaiḥmahābalāḥpravaro medhātithiścaivacchedako dahanastathāvāmājjyeṣṭhādayastatra śodhanīyā vipaścitaiḥsuśivaśca śivaścaiva kathitā anupūrvaśaḥmado moho mahāmohaḥ coṣavaicitryameva caata ūrdhvantu oṅkāraṃ veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥdhyānāhāraṃ samākhyātaṃ bhasmeśaṃ tadanantarampañcārthaguhyakañcaiva rudrāṅkuśamataḥ paramākarṣakassamākhyāto mayā tatvasya madhyataḥkathitaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ yonibhūtaṃ mahādhiyātathā balavikāraṇī balapramathinī * * ?atordhvaṃ īśvaraṃ tatvaṃ veditavyaṃ samāhitaḥekanetraikarudraśca trimūrtiścānaladyutiḥ* * * ? ntu pravakṣyāmi rūpacatuṣṭayaṃ tathāata ūrdhvantu deveśi śaktayastrīṇi kīrtitāḥpaśoryojanaviśeṣa uddhāre ca prakīrtitāḥupariṣṭāttu dve vidye veditavyāḥ prayatnataḥ
